data.description:
## Incident Overview

Bug-Fix Mode in /dso:debug-everything commits all fixes to the session branch and merges via a single PR at the end. When many bugs exist (e.g., 68 open), this produces one massive PR that is difficult to review and risky to merge.

## Expected Behavior

debug-everything should periodically merge batches of fixes to main in smaller PRs (e.g., every 5-10 fixes), similar to how Diagnostic Mode creates per-tier sub-branches.

## Actual Behavior

All fixes accumulate on the session branch and merge as one large PR in Phase L. The user must manually request periodic merges.

## Resolution Path

Add a batch-merge mechanism to Bug-Fix Mode that:
1. Tracks fixes completed since last merge
2. After N fixes (configurable via debug.bug_fix_batch_size, default 5-10), triggers merge-to-main.sh
3. Creates a new session branch for the next batch
4. Tracks overall progress across batches
data.title: [debug-everything]: Bug-Fix Mode defaults to single large PR -> all fixes land in one unbounded diff
